name: SRY-box transcription factor 11
pathways: negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II
positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: SOX11 encodes transcription factor SOX-11. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to SOX11-related complex neurodevelopmental disorder with or without congenital anomalies (autosomal dominant); intellectual developmental disorder with microcephaly and with or without ocular malformations or hypogonadotropic hypogonadism (autosomal dominant).
